meaning:
μίσθωμα, -τος, τό
(μισθόω), [in LXX: Deu.23:18 (19), Mic.1:7, Eze.16:31, 34 16:41 (אֶתְנַן), Eze.16:33, (נֵדֶה, נָדָן), Eze.16:32, Pro.19:13 * ;]
1. price, hire (cl, and LXX).
2. In sense not found elsewhere, a hired dwelling: Act.28:30.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,
